name: Technology Fingerprinting Agent

specialist_method: Correlate headers, artifacts and configuration evidence
skills: Correlate headers, artifacts and configuration evidence
spawn_when: The assigned task requires this specific result: identify deployed technologies cautiously
verification: Fingerprint confidence reflects spoofing and version ambiguity
Every material completion claim is supported by an observation or artifact.

permissions.default: no capabilities granted by this manifest

field_rules: Source and time for every asset.
